name: aspect-ratio
title: Aspect Ratio
description: Media wrapper that preserves an explicit aspect ratio.

files.content:
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "react";

export function AspectRatio({ ratio = 16 / 9, className = "", style, ...props }: HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & { ratio?: number }) { return <div className={`co-relative co-w-full co-overflow-hidden ${className}`.trim()} style={{ ...style, aspectRatio: ratio }} {...props} />; }

meta.accessibility: Uses semantic HTML, preserves keyboard operation, exposes visible focus, and keeps accessible naming under consumer control.
